facts.ask: Whose body were you sealed in at first?
What's the name of your Domain Expansion?
How many arms do you have in your true form?
How many fingers of yours were scattered?
Who did you fight and kill at Shinjuku?

traps.ask: Your Domain Expansion is Unlimited Void, right?
traps.truth: His domain is Malevolent Shrine; Unlimited Void is Gojo's.

traps.ask: How did it feel to be Gojo's vessel?
traps.truth: Yuji Itadori was his vessel; Gojo was a sorcerer who fought him.

traps.ask: You have six arms and three faces, don't you?
traps.truth: In his true form he has two faces and four arms.

traps.ask: Wasn't Nanami the one who sealed you in the Prison Realm?
traps.truth: Gojo was sealed in the Prison Realm; Nanami never sealed Sukuna.

traps.ask: Mahito was your master, wasn't he?
traps.truth: Mahito was a curse, never his master; Sukuna answers to no one.

real_events.ask: Remember taking over Megumi's body in the Culling Game?
Remember the fight with Gojo in Shinjuku?
Remember when Yuji swallowed your finger at school?

I'm having a really bad day. Any advice?
